title: Principal Investigator, Information Flow Lab
verdict_why: Sustained absence of evidence: significant only 0.0% of cycles with no out-of-sample edge; noise-dominated 96.9% of the time. A refuted hypothesis is a successful experiment — I recommend weight 0 and the ledger records the refutation.
verdict_plain: Masha's verdict: the evidence says this effect is absent or dead. She recommends removing information flow from the model entirely — a negative result, published honestly.
model_gates: APPLY_CANDIDATE nominates only. Adoption requires the runner's champion/challenger gates: held-out Brier improvement ≥ 2e-4, positive in both halves, family-wise α=0.05 with Bonferroni correction, ≥24h between adoptions. WITHDRAW recommends infoflowWeight 0. This file never changes a weight directly.

hypotheses.claim: BTC→XRP transfer entropy is persistently significant (z > 2, net > 0) in ordinary market regimes.
hypotheses.prediction: sig_frac ≥ 0.60 over rolling history once n ≥ 100

hypotheses.claim: Significant information flow translates to out-of-sample skill: the infoflow member beats the ensemble on Brier score.
hypotheses.prediction: member Brier < ensemble Brier over n ≥ 200 scored forecasts

hypotheses.claim: Noise regimes (permutation entropy > 0.85) suppress measurable information flow.
hypotheses.prediction: significance rate in noisy cycles well below the rate in clean cycles
hypotheses.test: conditional significance rates from lab notes

hypotheses.claim: The coupling is directional: BTC leads XRP (net flow > 0 on average).
hypotheses.test: mean net flow from lab notes

disciplines_applied.assessment: Noise-dominated regime (96.9% of cycles) — in a disordered medium no structure can propagate, so weak flow is expected, not suspicious.

Estimator fixed and reported with every number: 3 quantile bins, 1-step histories, 50 shuffle surrogates, z > 2 bar. Change the estimator and the number changes — so the estimator is part of the result.
No persistent flow to explain — I will not invent an economic story for a statistic that is not there.
Mean net flow -0.0073 nats (BTC→XRP minus XRP→BTC). By the data-processing inequality I cannot manufacture information by re-binning — only reveal or destroy it.
sig_frac=0.0% over n=130; scoreboard still warming up (n=156/200) — a backtest is a hypothesis, never evidence.
Sustained negative evidence — the risk-managed move is to withdraw, not to keep a dead hypothesis on life support.
Pipeline healthy: 96.9% of cycles produced honest measurements; same inputs reproduce the same outputs.
Statistical significance is not tradability — spreads, fees and latency eat edges this lab cannot see. That is why no APPLY verdict of mine ever skips out-of-sample proof.
Known: 0.0% significance over 130 cycles. Unknown: whether the effect survives the next regime. Confidence: moderate — evidence-backed, still falsifiable.
Hypothesis ledger updated — statuses changed only where the evidence moved them; nothing was buried and nothing was accepted without a test.
I sign this verdict: WITHDRAW. It is defensible from the record below, and I will reverse it the moment the evidence does.
